services.title: Full Service Design
services.description: Substantial renovations and new builds are shaped from early planning through to handover, with spatial planning, documentation, site decisions, furnishing, installation and final placement developed with cohesive direction. The project feels connected from the larger planning decisions through to the final pieces.

services.title: Furnishing & Procurement
services.description: Furniture, lighting, rugs, artwork and custom pieces are planned, selected, procured and installed in relation to the architecture, room proportions and the way each area is used. The furnished areas feel settled, comfortable, well scaled and ready to live in from installation.

services.title: Pre-Purchase Design Review
services.description: Before a property is purchased, Patina Design Studio assesses whether its layout, light, storage, proportions and renovation potential can support the buyer’s requirements. The review looks beyond presentation to identify both opportunity and limitation before commitment.

services.title: Layout Assessment
services.description: An existing floor plan may satisfy approvals or construction requirements without fully supporting the people who will live there. Patina Design Studio independently reviews flow, room relationships, furniture planning, storage and daily use before the plan is relied on.

services.title: Design Positioning Strategy
services.description: Properties being renovated, built or developed for sale need design decisions shaped around the intended buyer rather than broad assumptions about the market. The focus is on layout, finishes, furnishing direction and presentation choices that support buyer appeal and perceived value. The same approach may also be applied to selected rental developments where the intended tenant materially affects the design direction.

services.title: Design Consultation
services.description: Before a larger scope or design work begins, Patina Design Studio takes time to understand the property, priorities and brief. The consultation provides the context to identify the right service pathway, scope, fee estimate and next steps.
